title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: target
text:
target
target
(definition)
Definition:
The
vertex
which an
edge
of a
directed graph
enters.
See also
source
,
st-digraph
.
Note:
That is, an edge goes from the source to the target.
